messages:
jenny-sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeBank POC needs an auth plan. They require SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning + fine-grained RBAC and strict domain controls. Can eng confirm what's supported and what we should call out in the quote?

 tom-solutions: @jenny-sales we support SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated). Need IdP metadata, certificate, and attribute mappings. Do they require persistent NameID?

 jenny-sales: They want persistent NameID and eppn/email mapping. Also signed assertions and audience restriction to our SP entityID.

 anika-eng: We support signed assertions (SHA256) and Audience/Recipient checks. Persistent NameID is fine. For attribute mapping we accept email, name, and custom attrs. SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 with bulk + delta endpoints. NOTE: delta is eventually consistent for groups — we upsert on group member writes.

 luke-security: Quick security asks: SAML signatures SHA256 ok, request/response encryption optional. For SCIM transport we prefer OAuth bearer over HTTPS; mTLS is available for Dedicated/Private deployments.

 sasha-se: RBAC recommendation: use SCIM groups to map to Redwood roles. We expose roles via a SAML claim ("redwood:role") and via group membership in the SCIM representation. For the POC we can provision four starter roles: viewer, editor, admin, billing.

 tom-solutions: Pricing note — SCIM/provisioning API calls count against hosted rate quotas. For Dedicated/Private we include a provisioning allowance in the quote. @jenny-sales what's the initial MAU for their POC?

 jenny-sales: POC numbers: 50 active users initially, plan to ramp to ~500 over 3 months. Need hosted per-request vs dedicated reserved pricing breakout.

 anika-eng: For the POC we recommend hosted with reserved burst capacity. Operational constraints: default SCIM rate limit = 8 req/s per tenant; bulk endpoint supports up to 200 users per call. If they need sustained higher throughput, recommend Dedicated.

 luke-security: Security questionnaire items to collect from customer: SAML metadata, cert thumbprint, expected NameID format, SCIM callback IP allowlist (if any). We'll provide our security checklist and SOC-type links: https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim.

 infra-bot: [automated] Created ticket "AcmeBank POC - identity" (#INC-4123) and attached initial checklist.

 sasha-se: Domain controls: we support an enforced email domain allowlist and DNS TXT verification for domain ownership. Onboarding step: customer places TXT _redwood-verification.<domain> = "acme-acmebank-xyz" and we verify.

 jenny-sales: Action items: @anika-eng prepare a 1-page runbook (SAML attribute mapping + SCIM examples), @luke-security fill the questionnaire answers, @tom-solutions draft pricing options (hosted per-req + monthly seats vs Dedicated reserved) by EOD Friday. I'll send the ask to the buyer once runbook ready.

 tom-solutions: ack :thumbsup:

 anika-eng: I'll add a minimal SCIM example for the runbook below:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "jdoe@acme.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value":"jdoe@acme.com","primary":true}],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"employeeNumber":"1234"}
}
```

 sasha-se: SCIM group delta example we accept:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/abcdef
[ {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123"}]} ]
```

 jenny-sales: Perfect, thanks all. I'll loop the buyer and request their IdP metadata and a test tenant. We'll reconvene after they share metadata.
